gold.label: Written in gold: the gift is half as strong again.

red.label: Written in red: the gift is stronger, and so is the price.

why.dark: For one who stays up late.
why.cruising: Because it has been too easy.
why.wanted: Because the law is after you.
why.war: Because there is a war on.

open_hands.name: The Law of Open Hands
open_hands.gift: What you slay leaves twice as much behind.
open_hands.second: And half as many again walk at night.
open_hands.line: There. Monsters drop more. I'm told that's the fun part. I've written the other half very small.

deep_wells.name: The Law of Deep Wells
deep_wells.line: Your well fills itself now. The water has to come from somewhere, though. It always does.

soft_ground.name: The Law of Soft Ground
soft_ground.gift: Falls do a quarter of the harm.
soft_ground.line: The ground has agreed to be nicer about it. It asked that you stay closer to it, in return.

long_day.name: The Law of the Long Day
long_day.second: What walks at night comes harder.
long_day.line: More sun for you! The dark didn't like that. It's been told to wait, and it's waiting angrily.

honest_stone.name: The Law of Honest Stone
honest_stone.gift: Ore gives double, half the time.
honest_stone.second: Tools wear out twice as fast.
honest_stone.line: The rock gives more up now. It takes it out of your pickaxe.

fair_measure.name: The Law of Fair Measure
fair_measure.second: They pay you less as well.
fair_measure.line: Everything's cheaper! Merchants have noticed. Merchants always notice.

swift_feet.name: The Law of Swift Feet
swift_feet.line: Faster! You weigh about the same, and you're going to hit things harder. Mind that.

red_hand.name: The Law of the Red Hand
red_hand.gift: Your blows hit a third harder.
red_hand.line: You'll hit harder. I'd rather you didn't enjoy it, but I've seen your face.

iron_skin.name: The Law of Iron Skin
iron_skin.gift: You take a quarter less harm.
iron_skin.line: Your skin's a little more certain of itself. Your fists are a little less.

quick_stone.name: The Law of Quick Stone
quick_stone.gift: You mine half as fast again.
quick_stone.line: Stone gives way faster for you. All that digging is going to catch up with your legs.

hungry_night.name: The Law of the Hungry Night
hungry_night.gift: Faith comes half as fast again.
hungry_night.line: People pray harder in the dark. So I've made more dark. I don't feel great about it.

rich_road.name: The Law of the Rich Road
rich_road.gift: Bounties and rewards pay half as much again.
rich_road.line: More coin in your purse! And in everyone else's, which is the problem with coin.

mercy.name: The Law of Mercy
mercy.gift: Wounds close three times as fast.
mercy.line: That one's just for you. It costs me a little to look away this much, but I can spare it.

cold_iron.name: The Law of Cold Iron
cold_iron.gift: Your blows hit a fifth harder.
cold_iron.line: Iron's cold, and it doesn't care. Your well won't care much either, for a while.

good_hunt.name: The Law of the Good Hunt
good_hunt.gift: What you slay leaves half as much again.
good_hunt.second: What walks at night comes a little harder.
good_hunt.line: Good hunting! I mean that as a Law, not a greeting. They've all heard about it, by the way.

still_water.name: The Law of Still Water
still_water.gift: Mana returns half as fast again.
still_water.line: Be calm, and it fills up. Being calm is bad for punching. I don't make the rules. I do, actually, but only the small ones.

patient_stone.name: The Law of Patient Stone
patient_stone.line: Your tools will last. You'll have to be a bit more polite to the rock.

open_palm.name: The Law of the Open Palm
open_palm.gift: What lies on the ground comes to you from three times as far.
open_palm.line: Things want to be yours now. It's a little clingy, honestly. Don't let it go to your head.

good_hearth.name: The Law of the Good Hearth
good_hearth.line: Everyone's fire burns hotter. Firewood sellers are delighted. That's why bread costs more.

iron_purse.name: The Law of the Iron Purse
iron_purse.second: They charge a little more, too.
iron_purse.line: Sell high! Everyone else is selling high too. It's called the economy. I think I broke it.

open_door.name: The Law of the Open Door
open_door.line: Doors open, prices drop. The guild is furious, which I've decided to find funny.

lean_years.name: The Law of Lean Years
lean_years.gift: Wounds close half as fast again.
lean_years.second: What you slay leaves less behind.
lean_years.line: You'll mend. The world's going to be a bit stingy about it. It's always a bit stingy.

bright_tonic.name: The Law of the Bright Tonic
bright_tonic.gift: Food and potions restore twice as much.
bright_tonic.second: Wounds close more slowly on their own.
bright_tonic.line: Soup is twice as good now. I've never had soup. I've been told this is a big deal.

hard_shell.name: The Law of the Hard Shell
hard_shell.gift: Armour guards you two fifths better.
hard_shell.line: Your armour's on your side now. It's still heavy. It wanted me to mention that.

light_step.name: The Law of the Light Step
light_step.second: Falls do half as much harm again.
light_step.line: Up you go! The coming down is the same as ever, only more so.

pilgrim.name: The Law of the Pilgrim
pilgrim.second: Your deeds earn a little less Faith.
pilgrim.line: For the road! I do like a walker. You'll be harder to keep an eye on, is all.

wide_fields.name: The Law of Wide Fields
wide_fields.gift: Twice as many beasts roam the land.
wide_fields.second: A few more monsters come with them.
wide_fields.line: Deer! So many deer! Something's been following the deer, though. I'd look into that.

witness.name: The Law of the Witness
witness.line: I've asked them to watch you a bit more closely. Being watched turns out to be expensive.

quiet_name.name: The Law of the Quiet Name
quiet_name.gift: Hunts for you end twice as fast.
quiet_name.line: People forget your face sooner. The good bits too, but mostly the other bits.

quick_hands.name: The Law of Quick Hands
quick_hands.second: Your blows land a little softer.
quick_hands.line: Quick, quick, quick! I don't know what you're doing with those hands, and I'm not sure I want to.

sure_hand.name: The Law of the Sure Hand
sure_hand.gift: One blow in five lands double.
sure_hand.second: Tools and blades wear half as fast again.
sure_hand.line: Sometimes you'll just get it exactly right. Your sword will feel that as much as they do.

heavy_hand.name: The Law of the Heavy Hand
heavy_hand.gift: Your blows throw things twice as far.
heavy_hand.line: Go away! That's the Law. It's mostly a Law about going away.

fletcher.name: The Law of the Fletcher
fletcher.gift: Arrows strike half as hard again.
fletcher.line: Your arrows have opinions now. Your arm has a few as well.

thorned_skin.name: The Law of Thorns
thorned_skin.gift: What strikes you is struck for half of it.
thorned_skin.line: Everything that hits you gets some of it back. You're going to be very unpleasant to hug.

still_air.name: The Law of Still Air
still_air.gift: One blow in seven misses you.
still_air.line: Sometimes the air just decides you're somewhere else. Armour finds this confusing.

ember_heart.name: The Law of the Ember Heart
ember_heart.line: There's a coal in your chest now. It's fine. It's mostly fine. Don't sleep on your front.

thin_well.name: The Law of the Thin Well
thin_well.line: A little goes further. There's going to be a little less of it. That's how a little works.

open_sky.name: The Law of Open Sky
open_sky.gift: Flight costs less than half the mana.
open_sky.second: Falls do half as much harm again.
open_sky.line: The sky likes you. The ground's a bit jealous, and it knows where you'll land.

tide.name: The Law of the Tide
tide.gift: You swim half as fast again.
tide.line: The water will carry you. It wants you back afterwards, a little. That's the heavy feeling.

fair_wage.name: The Law of the Fair Wage
fair_wage.gift: Bounties and rewards pay twice over.
fair_wage.line: An honest day's coin! For you. The merchants would like a word, and it isn't an honest one.

blood_price.name: The Law of the Blood Price
blood_price.line: I'm not proud of that one. It works, though. Please don't look like you're enjoying it.

shadow_step.name: The Law of the Shadow Step
shadow_step.gift: Monsters notice you from half as far.
shadow_step.line: They'll look right past you. So will I, sometimes. Don't tell me where you are.

short_night.name: The Law of the Short Night
short_night.second: What walks at night comes harder.
short_night.line: Less dark! The dark's going to try to do the same amount of dark in half the time.

glass_blade.name: The Law of the Glass Blade
glass_blade.gift: Your blows hit twice as hard.
glass_blade.second: Blows land three quarters harder on you.
glass_blade.line: One clean hit. For both of you. I hope you've thought about who goes first.

storm_feet.name: The Law of Storm Feet
storm_feet.gift: You run half as fast again.
storm_feet.second: Blows land half as hard again.
storm_feet.line: You're going to be very hard to catch, and very easy to break. Mind the corners.

merchant_king.name: The Law of the Merchant King
merchant_king.gift: Shops charge half, and pay half as much again.
merchant_king.second: Rewards shrink, and blows land harder.
merchant_king.line: Everything is for sale, and you've got the good prices. Someone's going to come for you over this.

bottomless.name: The Law of the Bottomless Well
bottomless.gift: Spells cost half, and strike a quarter harder.
bottomless.line: There's no floor down there now. I looked. I wouldn't lean over the edge if I were you.

golden_touch.name: The Law of the Golden Touch
golden_touch.gift: Every vein gives double, and often more.
golden_touch.second: Tools wear three times as fast.
golden_touch.line: The rock's in love with you. It's a very expensive relationship, and your pickaxe is paying for it.

second_sun.name: The Law of the Second Sun
second_sun.gift: Night is over almost as it begins.
second_sun.second: What walks at night comes half as strong again.
second_sun.line: I've made the dark very short. It's been saving up. You're going to meet what it saved.

thirteenth_hour.name: The Law of the Thirteenth Hour
thirteenth_hour.second: Far more monsters walk at night.
thirteenth_hour.line: There's an extra hour in the night now, and everyone's praying through it. Something else got in with it.

hollow_king.name: The Law of the Hollow King
hollow_king.line: The last person who asked for that one is a very long way down. I'd keep moving, if I were you.
